title: Porter's value chain
caption: Five primary activities take a product from inputs to after-sales service; four support activities run beneath all of them. Margin is what customers pay for the value minus the cost of these activities.
alt: A chain of five primary activities (inbound logistics, operations, outbound logistics, marketing and sales, service) with four support activities above, ending in margin.
description: Support activities: firm infrastructure, human resource management, technology development and procurement.
Primary activities in order: inbound logistics, operations, outbound logistics, marketing and sales, service.
The difference between value and cost is the margin.
end: Margin = value to customers − cost of the activities
